[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Tabs mean pages, the view chip, and the lock[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]tabs-chip[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tabs-chip: card tabs only for paged multi-card decks, a solid view chip [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with a lock replacing auto/fixed, a spread you-are-here title with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]structural ▴/▾ cues, the jump/cards footer label, and the "locked" [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vocabulary.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Lock-toggle key and lock copy[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]lock-key[dim] · [dim][/dim]after tabs-chip[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]lock-key: an Agents-only action that locks the layout auto chose or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]returns to automatic, wired through keymaps, availability, palette, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]footer, help, the first-lock toast, and generated keymap docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Viewport-precise spread cues and the paged continuation cue[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]viewport-cues[dim] · [dim][/dim]after lock-key[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]viewport-cues: one refresh-on-change scope key per panel drives [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in-view-aware spread cues, the "all in view" state, and a bottom-border [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]+N cue for paged decks that turns bold at the bottom.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Docs, glossary, and acceptance review[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]docs-acceptance[dim] · [dim][/dim]after viewport-cues[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]paragraph, apply the glossary decision, and verify the five acceptance [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]criteria with live screenshots and goldens.[/#D7D7AF]
